originalTitle: The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct 9.8.2026
content: Join us on September 8 at 7am PT / 10am ET for The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct. To celebrate the series’ 40th anniversary, we will deliver a variety of The Legend of Zelda related information.
